Author: XeldarAlz; local Discord adaptation
Name: Aethr App (local Discord)
Punchline: Your existing phone interface with your Discord friends.
Description: Private local edition based on Aetherphone. Uses official Discord authorization for contacts and text chat. Aethernet services and unchecked native media/browser playback are disabled.

Author: YF
Name: Musical Guide (local camera R6)
Description: Local experimental camera R6. /mguide opens settings. Adds saved opt-in automatic hand-clipping reduction for verified local first-person projections. Enable Automatically restore hand-clipping reduction in First Person Adjustments / Hand clipping. Not an official upstream release. Native game acceptance remains pending.
Punchline: Enhanced camera distance control and first-person experience.

Author: Risa and Contributors
Name: Customize+ (local NearFace fork)
Punchline: Customize your character beyond FFXIV's limitations.
Description: Local experimental fork of Customize+ 2.2.1.3. Original profiles remain active; optional local face/head layers compose inside the existing render boundary. Not an official Aether Tools release. Native visual calibration is required.

Author: NearFace contributors
Name: NearFace Local Controls (prototype)
Description: Local prototype. /nearface opens controls. Start live session explicitly starts the bundled webcam helper and local receiver; Stop or plugin unload stops the owned helper. Nothing opens the camera automatically. Fresh numeric coefficients go over IPv4 loopback to the matching C+ fork. Animation components start disabled and need visual calibration. Saved C+ profiles and other players are not modified or synchronized.
Punchline: Local face controls and read-only bone inventory for the matching C+ fork.
